brief:
Avi Gill, former military secretary to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, said the Israeli public has not been told the full truth about events on October 7, 2023, Shehab Wire reported. Gill did not elaborate on the specific allegations in the available excerpt.

The claim adds to ongoing disputes over official narratives surrounding the Hamas-led attack and Israel's subsequent military response in Gaza.
